title: Feedback please.

selftext:

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
just my 2 cents from someone who has also been dealing with ai animations:

\* you probably want a bigger frame/sprite size. some of your frame gets cut off

\* you can consider excluding special effects in your prompts. I personally don't have a good experience with the sprites whenever AI adds shadows, smoke or fancy weapon effects

\* I got this tip from another person on this sub but basically you can generate one video for all the animations you need from the character and you would get a more consistent result

replies.author: Useful_Use_6170
replies.body: Nice! I didn’t know that you can get a sprite sheet out of a video ? Would you mind pointing me in the right direction ?

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
hmm, you can just take snapshot of the video and lay them out. thats a spritesheet. there are apps and tools that do that for you automatically too

if you try one of those aigamedev dedicated ai apps, they do all this for you and you just prompt for the animation

comments.author: Southern_Charge5794
comments.body:
I always told that animation via nano banana or GPT Image is a dead end as for this particular use case image-to-video models has been created. Just try Kling AI and compare result.   
Pipeline is pretty the same. You extracting frames -> remove background -> manual processing if needed -> adding into your scene. In example below I asked AI to create a GIF from my idle animations that technically sprite sheets. Like 4-5 different animations. Some sprites are little cropped in GIF but not cropped in game.  
Usually I extract every third frame and compress it into target resolution

https://i.redd.it/qqmo1iz4g14h1.gif

replies.author: Useful_Use_6170
replies.body: Oh wow that is so clean!! Teach me ur ways!!

replies.author: Southern_Charge5794
replies.body: Most of AI image-to-video models do have start and end frame. Approach is pretty much the same you are writing prompt what you are trying to achieve and validate results. Once you satisfied you downloading your video and starting extraction part. In my case I asked AI to write scripts for me to remove background and when I was satisfied created another script to create a sprite sheet animation. With sprite sheet I am currently experimenting with VFX like sword attack but this is different story

replies.author: Useful_Use_6170
replies.body: Nice!! If you don’t mind me asking what video generator are you using? And to remove backgrounds and extract the images ? What’s your whole process including tools if you don’t mind me asking

replies.author: Southern_Charge5794
replies.body: I am using Kling AI. Right now there are hype around new version of Seedance, maybe it also can do the job. The rest is manually written tools. I do not use any paid tools except of Github Copilot but will move to Codex next week.
